name: darkpool-launchpad
description: Private Darkpool Launchpad - Bot-resistant token launches with Noir ZK proofs

scripts.build:circuits: cd circuits/check_eligibility && nargo compile && mkdir -p ../../frontend/src && cp target/check_eligibility.json ../../frontend/src/
scripts.build:programs: anchor build && mkdir -p frontend/src/idl && cp target/idl/*.json frontend/src/idl/
scripts.build:all: npm run build:circuits && npm run build:programs
